title: Alex Imas & Tyler Cowen | AI Is Moving Fast. Why Isn’t the Economy?
content: Economists Alex Imas and Tyler Cowen discuss the disconnect between rapid AI capability improvements and slower economic growth. They analyze factors like market bottlenecks, falling AI costs, and the productivity gains necessary to justify high valuations. The conversation explores how these dynamics influence jobs, wages, and macroeconomic expansion. A central thesis argues that the most significant economic shifts may arise from AI agents learning to coordinate at scale, rather than from isolated improvements in individual agent intelligence.

title: 黄仁勋想回来，AI却回不去了
content: Jensen Huang’s departure from NVIDIA marks a structural shift in the AI industry. The sector faces a crisis of confidence as leverage-driven expansion clashes with physical constraints like power availability and infrastructure delays. Financial models that assumed infinite future demand now require rigorous credit reassessment. Consequently, market valuations are destabilizing, and investment is becoming more rational. This transition exposes vulnerabilities in the supply chain and highlights that AI’s growth is limited by tangible, real-world delivery capabilities rather than just technological potential.

title: 怡红院的芳官只是洗了一次头，袭人、晴雯、麝月为什么全上场了 | 原文
content: This excerpt from *Dream of the Red Chamber* analyzes the incident in Chapter 58 where Fang Guan, a young performer, refuses to wash her hair with water left over by a servant's daughter. The conflict triggers interventions from senior maids Xiren, Qingwen, and Shuyue. Xiren resolves the immediate situation by providing fresh water and toiletries. The analysis argues this episode illustrates Yihong Yuan’s core management flaw: while staff address immediate inconveniences, no individual assumes accountability for overall outcomes, revealing systemic dysfunction rather than mere interpersonal conflict.

title: 又被​赛博安全关照​了
content: A developer reported that cybersecurity false positives in AI coding assistants are blocking work on an Android kernel upgrade project. Despite attempts to circumvent restrictions using "continue" prompts, lower-tier models, or new sessions, the block persisted. Using an alternative free model revealed that an automated process was endlessly prepending status updates to the AGENTS.md file, creating a megabyte-sized prompt filled with terms like UAF that triggered security filters. Cleaning this file resolved the issue, prompting a community discussion on effectively bypassing such false positives.

title: 李沐加入 Aimotion 出任联合创始人兼 CTO
content: Li Mu has assumed the role of co-founder and CTO at Aimotion, a Silicon Valley AI firm specializing in high-value industries, while retaining his position at Boson AI. The companies will integrate Boson AI’s foundational models with Aimotion’s commercial scenarios to develop industrial world models. This initiative aims to advance AI agents from passive tools to autonomous systems capable of executing complex sales tasks, thereby enhancing real-world business efficiency. Aimotion recently secured a multi-million dollar Series A led by BAI Capital.
